name: ghmc_winners
title: GHMC winners
description: One row per ward winner and election.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Municipal corporation explicitly identified by all sources.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Ward identifier, printed or linked as described by ward_link_basis.

fields.name: ward_name_raw
fields.description: Printed ward name; candidate returns use the official winner-table name.

fields.name: ward_source_path
fields.description: Repository-relative source supporting the ward identifier.

fields.name: ward_link_basis
fields.description: Evidence used for the ward identifier.

fields.name: ward_label_cell_raw
fields.description: Original return ward cell, including blank or truncated text; full source cells remain in raw_record.

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Name of the elected officeholder, whitespace normalized.

fields.name: winner_woman_raw
fields.description: Separately printed winner sex;null throughout2016.

fields.name: winner_woman
fields.description: 1=female,0=male,null=unknown;never inferred from reservation/name.

fields.name: party
fields.description: Printed party label, not harmonized across sources.

fields.name: votes
fields.description: Valid votes printed for this candidate or winner; null if source does not report votes.

fields.name: reserved_raw
fields.description: Printed adopted seat reservation, identified by reserved_source_path.

fields.name: reserved_caste
fields.description: Normalized seat caste quota; NONE means no caste restriction.

fields.name: reserved_woman
fields.description: Recorded women reservation:1=yes,0=no,null=unknown. Independent of officeholder sex.

fields.name: reserved_basis
fields.description: Source-cell reading or separately recorded official winner-table reservation.

fields.name: reserved_source_path
fields.description: Repository-relative source used for adopted seat reservation.

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Repository-relative original candidate/winner source.

fields.name: source_page
fields.description: One-based physical PDF page.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: 2016 text line;2020 return table row;profile printed serial;winner printed ward serial.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA256 of original source_path bytes.

fields.name: raw_record
fields.description: JSON of complete original extracted line/cells, with source values unchanged.
